name: bridge-get-status
description: Slim ChievFX bridge health snapshot: heartbeat, compile/import busy state, recent operations, and event-wait liveness. Check before longer orchestration. Pass verbose=true for full diagnostics.

verbose.description: Return the full diagnostic shape (editor/busy/eventWaits/counts blocks plus per-op timestamps).

maxOperations.description: Maximum recent (terminal) operation rows to include. Defaults to 0; active ops are always returned when present.
